batch_scope_name_events.source_text_ja: もう1話分ネームが上がり、

progress_coordinate.page_log: 0.01 per observed manuscript page, capped at 0.19
progress_coordinate.note: Status flags are retained separately; the coordinate is furthest observed progress, not a claim of irreversible sequential work.

all_pairs_coordinate_likelihood.delta_c: target publication coordinate minus event coordinate
all_pairs_coordinate_likelihood.note: All coordinate pairs inform each historical batch component; components, not pairs, are averaged.

no_start_update: The posterior support and stale-analog fade are conditioned through each issue publicly known not to contain the batch; production-event likelihoods are otherwise unchanged during silence.

next_batch.evidence: Level 1 direct two-gap prior H = G1 + G2, conditioned on the preceding batch's observed non-start. Production events are deliberately not used again here, avoiding a second use of following-batch evidence.

two_gap_prior.conditioning: historical pairs with G1 >= elapsed first gap

correlation_note: Each analog contributes ONE likelihood factor. The per-chapter readiness states summarise correlated tweets; treating every event as independent would badly over-sharpen the posterior. Same-batch readiness has weight 0.75; preceding-batch production context has weight 0.25. Stale analogs fade smoothly to neutral.
